insight: Founded by Brooke Hopkins, who built evaluation infrastructure for self-driving cars at Waymo; a YC Summer 2024 company.
name: Coval
tagline: Simulation and evaluation platform for voice and chat AI agents.
description: Coval is an evaluation and monitoring platform for conversational AI agents, applying the simulation-driven testing rigor developed in self-driving to voice and chat. From a handful of test cases it generates thousands of realistic scenarios, runs them against an agent over text or live phone calls, and scores the results on built-in or custom metrics. In production it monitors and scores real calls so teams can catch regressions across millions of conversations.

modelSupport.notes: Tests any voice or chat agent regardless of the underlying model or framework.

edge: Brings autonomous-vehicle-style simulation testing to voice agents — turns a few test cases into thousands of scenarios and scores live calls.
pros: Generates realistic scenarios from few cases
Tests both voice and chat agents
Runs over text and live phone calls
cons: Younger than general LLM eval tools
